landing.badge: Technical analysis · Patterns · AI forecast · Backtest
landing.subtitle: Candlestick charts, classic indicators, candlestick pattern recognition, and an AI that visually extends the chart with its forecast. Then compare it with what actually happened.
landing.feature1Desc: RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger, stochastic — with automatic buy/sell/hold signals.
landing.feature2Desc: Doji, hammer, engulfing, morning/evening star, three white soldiers and more, detected on recent candles.
landing.feature3Desc: An AI model extends your chart with N forecast candles overlaid on the real data.
landing.feature4Desc: Pick a past date, generate the forecast as of that day, compare it with what actually happened.
landing.feature5Desc: Save your symbols and open the analysis with one click.
landing.feature6Desc: Every saved prediction is evaluated after the fact: MAPE, correct direction, max error.
landing.footer: Educational tool. Not financial advice. Data source: Twelve Data.

auth.footer: No financial advice. Educational tools only.

dashboard.subtitle: Search a symbol, open it, and ask the AI for a forecast.
dashboard.watchlistEmpty: Still empty. Search a symbol above and save it.

analyze.noPatterns: No relevant patterns in recent candles.
analyze.forecastHint: Click "Generate forecast" to extend the chart with {{horizon}} AI-predicted candles.
analyze.bandHint: The dashed band on the chart shows a plausible range (±1 historical standard deviation), not another AI-predicted scenario.

manual.title: Manual entry
manual.subtitle: Look at the chart you're interested in (screenshot, TradingView, etc.) and type in the OHLC values here. No data is estimated by the AI: the numbers are exactly what you enter.
manual.symbolLabel: Symbol / name (free text, doesn't need to exist on Yahoo)
manual.pasteHint: One candle per line, values separated by comma or tab:
manual.needMoreCandles: You need at least 15 valid candles to generate an AI forecast (you have {{count}}). You can still see indicators and patterns with what you've entered.
manual.photoSectionTitle: Extract from a photo (estimate, review before use)
manual.photoHint: Upload a photo of the chart, specify how many candles are visible, and enter the real OHLC values of at least one candle (ideally two, e.g. the first and last) to calibrate the price scale. The AI estimates the other candles — these are approximate numbers, review them before proceeding.
manual.visibleCandlesQuestion: How many candles are visible in the chart?
manual.extractReplaceHint: This will replace the current rows in the table below with the estimated candles.
manual.extractSuccess: {{count}} candles estimated from the photo — review them before proceeding
manual.extractMissingTotal: Specify how many candles are visible in the chart
manual.extractMissingCalibration: At least one filled-in calibration candle is required
manual.aiForecastGeneric: Click "Generate forecast" to extend the chart with {{horizon}} AI-predicted candles, calculated from the data you entered.
manual.indicatorsHint: Indicators that need more history than what you entered (e.g. SMA200 with few candles) show "—".
manual.noPatterns: No relevant patterns in the entered candles.
manual.pasteHintSuffix: (volume optional). Dates are generated automatically in sequence based on the duration chosen above.

backtest.title: Backtest
backtest.subtitle: Pick a historical date, generate the forecast as if it were that day, and compare it with what really happened.
backtest.needMoreHistory: Need more history before the chosen date
backtest.needMoreFuture: Not enough subsequent history to evaluate
backtest.probabilityBeforeOutcome: Directional probability estimated by the AI (before knowing the outcome)
backtest.pageSubtitle: Pick a past date. The AI will generate the forecast using only data up to that date, and we'll compare it with what actually happened afterwards.

predictions.title: Saved predictions
predictions.subtitle: Each prediction can be evaluated after the fact by comparing the predicted candles with the actual ones that followed.
predictions.statsEmpty: No predictions evaluated yet — use "Evaluate" below or try a backtest to start building a real track record, instead of trusting it blindly.
predictions.coinFlipHint: 50% direction accuracy is equivalent to a coin flip — it's the minimum baseline to tell whether the AI is doing anything useful on this kind of data.
predictions.empty: No predictions saved. Go to a symbol and click "Save".

marubozu_black.description: Full body with no shadows: strong directional pressure.
